notes.title: Mechanisms always use science
notes.text: Every cause, digestive-process explanation and ingredient-role explanation is full-frame scientific imagery. No talking heads, actor picture-in-picture or small anatomy insets during those lines. Podcast framing remains for the opening, questions, practical product bridge, patient-goal discussion and CTA.

notes.title: Timing and audio
notes.text: 190 delivered words/minute; 0.16s intra-card speaker handoffs; 0.7s end hold. Provisional, not an aligned audio timeline. Final narration 1.1× maximum per user direction; remove dead air first and align cues to actual words. Keep intelligible breaths and short turn-taking pauses. B-roll audio stays muted; speech and continuous room tone bridge cuts. No automatic 1.2× stretch.

notes.title: Caption and overlay system
notes.text: Opening topic strip only during the initial stacked exchange. Then bold white uppercase captions, usually 1–4 words, soft dark shadow, near 60–70% of frame height. Scientific labels stay in the upper third. Keep faces, mouths and bottom platform UI zone unobstructed. Overlays enter on the word they explain.

notes.title: Transitions
notes.text: Hard cuts for speaker changes and B-roll entries/exits. Carry the speaking audio continuously under inserts. Occasional restrained punch-in at a conclusion, approximately 1.08–1.12×. No whip pans, page wipes, noisy whooshes or recurring animated title cards.

notes.title: Scientific direction
notes.text: One clean anatomy style: translucent torso, peach organs, dark teal field, restrained blue for water. Show stomach emptying, intestinal contractions and colon hydration as distinct processes. No stool in stomach, fake studies, product-triggered gut reboot or invented biochemical reactions. Ingredient-role claims remain subject to the evidence limitations in source-notes.md.

notes.title: Presenter concepts
notes.text: Latest direction uses the two speaking reference presenters as visual concepts. Generated likeness images carry an AI concept / not-an-endorsement footer. They are not evidence of actual participation, credentials or a product endorsement. Script dialogue is unchanged and is not attributed as a real quote by these people.

notes.title: Product source correction
notes.text: The old S27/S28 packshot proxies visibly include stale 5 g / other front-label claims. They are composition references only. Use current approved product artwork for final shots; exactly two green heart-shaped gummies. Verify final physical label reference before media generation.

notes.title: Production routing
notes.text: User update: Kie.ai for generation; GPT Image 2.5 Flare for images. Google Omni remains the video model, and the current documented internal editor remains the editing route. Storyboard first, then final 1.1× audio timing, then motion and edit. Do not use Higgsfield or substitute another image model silently.
